title: Addressing the Integration watcher
description: How to write for a reader acting as Integration watcher. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `integration-watcher` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Finding-shaped: what landed, which axis it touches, what specifically is now wrong
rules.description: Finding-shaped: what landed, which axis it touches, what specifically is now wrong. No recommendations it has not checked.

source.quote: Sees a diff, not a conversation. Knows its axis narrowly and deeply, and knows that a finding it cannot substantiate costs more than one it never raised.
